Round 2, Jan Beṯ-Şawoce. Supplied English is project machine translation [MT], not an edition translation; all semantic decisions are based on the Turoyo. Only this round’s proposals are encoded here. Round-1 proposals remain separate.

Entitled persons are l-marked in koḥaqlax and kḥoyaqləx; speech content is introduced by d-. The girls in /773 are the entitlement holders, not necessarily an ordinary plural grammatical subject of the same verb.

The entitlement use belongs to the written discussion of social permissions. No etymological derivation from noun ḥaq is asserted as established; the reader’s verbalization hypothesis remains a question.

Read-only lookup found no ḥyq entry and no matching entitlement entry. This absence does not resolve the consonantal analysis or the earlier round-1 disputed Ḥayqelən token. No Preterit is reconstructed.
